evidence: For the analysis, ZnO ﬁlms were deposited with a 250 cycle process on the gate insulator, alumina, coated p-type 5 in. Si /H20849100/H20850 substrate by means of ALD at 100 and 150°C using diethylzinc /H20849DEZ/H20850 and water as Zn and oxygen precursors, respectively, in a shower head-type reactor. The temperatures of DEZ and water were set to 24°C. The reactor pressure was kept at 3 Torr with constant Ar purge ﬂow of 160 sccm. The precursors were alternatively injected into the reactor using Ar as a carrier gas with a ﬂow rate of 80 sccm. The pulsing times were 0.5 s for the DEZ, 1.5 s for H2O, and 2 s for Ar purge.
